errors.evidence: The description states that the years on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are arranged chronologically from 2016 to 2022.

errors.text_span: сините стълби показват стойности от 1,15% (2016) до 3,21% (2022)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the minimum value for the blue bars (Share of Bulgaria in Ukrainian export) is 1.15% in 2016. According to the chart, the actual minimum value for the blue bars is 0.96% in 2019.

The description incorrectly states that the minimum value for the red bars (Share of Bulgaria in Ukrainian import) is 0.44% in 2016. According to the chart, the actual minimum value for the red bars is 0.38% in 2017.

errors.text_span: синият стълб е по-висок от червената за всички години, освен в 2019 г., където червената стойност е по-висока от синята
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The blue bar is higher than the red bar for all years from 2016 to 2021. The only year where the red bar is higher than the blue bar is 2022 (3.72 vs 3.21). The description incorrectly identifies 2019 as the exception and also wrongly claims the red value was higher than the blue in 2019 (0.76 is lower than 0.96).
